ln:4462176744.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Work closely with the Relationship Management and Wealth Management teams in providing specialist services in business planning and joint meetings
  • Provide technical and skills coaching towards developing staff teams in order to achieve team business objectives
  • Supply timely market and product updates to both staff and customers
  • Work closely with the wealth management product teams and development team on new products, product enhancements and improvements in customer experience
  • Assist the frontline teams with all customer servicing needs and disputes in order to ensure seamless support is provided to our customers

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree with honors in economics, finance, business or a related discipline.
  • Working experience as a product specialist, financial advisor or sales manager.
  • Strong knowledge of all wealth management products and with expertise in customer portfolio management
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and presentation skills
  • A mature individual able to instill confidence with colleagues and clients alike
  • Fluent written and verbal English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

ln:4446712669.descriptionHtml:
International Wealth and Premier Banking

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as a senior subject matter expert in insurance planning, delivering insurance-led wealth and succession solutions to High Net Worth Individuals, with a strong focus on Asian clients, particularly from China.
  • Provide strategic advice on life insurance, legacy and estate liquidity planning, business succession funding, asset protection, and risk management as part of holistic wealth planning engagements.
  • Partner closely with Relationship Managers to identify client needs and originate planning opportunities, positioning insurance as a core advisory tool within broader wealth and succession planning discussions.
  • Design, structure, and implement complex insurance solutions tailored to clients’ personal, family, and business objectives, including intergenerational wealth transfer and long-term legacy planning.
  • Lead succession planning engagements, facilitating client and family discussions around protection planning, estate equalisation, liquidity needs, and philanthropic objectives.
  • Work collaboratively with internal partners, underwriting teams, and external specialists to deliver seamless end-to-end insurance advisory and execution.
  • Monitor wealth planning market developments, regulatory changes, and best practices across relevant jurisdictions, translating insights into compliant and effective client solutions.
  • Collaborate with Private Banking and Group affiliates to strengthen the Bank’s insurance proposition, support client acquisition, and deepen existing client relationships.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and intermediaries across the insurance and wealth planning ecosystem, positioning the Bank as a trusted advisory partner.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in insurance advisory, wealth planning, or private banking, with a strong focus on insurance-led solutions for High Net Worth Individuals.
  • Proven track record in structuring and delivering complex insurance solutions or legacy planning.
  • Travelling is required on need basis
  • Strong interpersonal, advisory, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior clients and family members.
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision; highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and execution-focused.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4442431964.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Are you ready to elevate your career in asset management? We invite you to become a vital member of our Client Advisor Team within the Hong Kong Intermediary Business. This is your opportunity to join a vibrant team in a high growth environment, where you can make a significant impact by delivering unparalleled client experiences through innovative and proactive sales strategies. Embrace the chance to grow professionally, develop your skills, and contribute to a team that values innovation and excellence.


As a Vice President Client Advisor in the Hong Kong Intermediary Business Team, you'll be at the forefront of engaging with established Retail Banks distribution clients and pioneering new ways to expand our client base. At J.P. Morgan Asset Management, we prioritize our clients, and we're seeking candidates who share our passion for excellence. Leverage our market leading investment platform, cutting-edge technology and CRM systems to identify opportunities and deliver groundbreaking solutions. We are committed to conducting 'first class business in a first-class way,' and we expect you to embody this ethos in every interaction.

If you're a self-starter with a positive attitude and a drive to develop market opportunities, we want to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of asset management and delivering exceptional client experiences.


Job Responsibilities

  • Build and implement client strategy to drive strategic business growth across the Retail Banks channel (Strategic Growth)
  • Develop and sustain strong relationships with key decision-makers, gatekeepers and bankers (Relationship Building)
  • Analyze industry trends and translate them into actionable business opportunities (Industry Insight)
  • Deliver commercial success, quality of service and risk-controls excellence of the overall business by working with internal stakeholders through day-to-day responsibilities, strategic initiatives, and projects (Leadership & Collaboration)
  • Collaborate to achieve overarching business objectives, including sales targets and key performance indicators (Team Success)


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Proven Expertise: Minimum of 8 years in the financial services industry with a robust track record and strong client relationships.
  • Positive & Growth Mindset: A go-getter attitude with the ability to bring fresh perspectives and new ideas to the team.
  • Product Mastery: Strong Knowledge of public and private capital markets.
  • Achievement Drive: Demonstrated success in a financial sales environment, with high energy and a results-oriented approach.
  • Relationship Management: Ability to build and manage relationships across the organization and with clients.
  • Integrity & Compliance: Strong fiduciary mindset with a commitment to risk control and ethical standards.
  • Communication Skills: Fluency in English and Cantonese is essential for effective client coverage.


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Professional Certification: CFA designation is desirable but not a must


ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.


About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

ln:4436225335.descriptionHtml:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
  • Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
  • Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
  • Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
  • Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
  • 10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
  • Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
  • Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Experience of covering local institutional investors
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

- Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
- Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
- Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
- Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
- Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
- Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
- Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
- Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications:
- 15+ years of relevant experience
- Experience in people management
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
- Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
- Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
- Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
- Series 79 and 63 licenses
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree preferred
- Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
- Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
- Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
- Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
- Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
- 10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
- Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
- Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
- Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
- Experience of covering local institutional investors
- Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
- Fluent in Mandarin and English
- Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics.

Business:CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 59162

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and implement semantic models for key domains, including customer/entity, onboarding journeys, credit exposures, limits, collateral, risk ratings, portfolio hierarchies, and performance measures.
  • Define and govern KPIs/metrics (e.g., onboarding turnaround time, KYC SLA adherence, application drop-off, approval rate, exposure at default, utilisation, arrears/delinquency, portfolio concentration, risk-adjusted returns), with documentation and lineage.
  • Translate business requirements into standard measures and conformed dimensions to ensure cross-domain consistency (e.g., customer, product, legal entity, booking location, time, risk grade).
  • Implement data quality and reconciliation controls to ensure metric correctness against source-of-truth platforms.
  • Optimise semantic performance and cost through appropriate modelling patterns, aggregation strategies, and incremental refresh approaches.
  • Apply security controls (RBAC/ABAC), row/column-level security and auditing to support controlled access to sensitive onboarding and credit data.
  • Operate the semantic layer in production: CI/CD, monitoring, incident triage, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Product Owners, Analysts, Risk and Operations stakeholders to drive adoption and consistent usage.

Requirements

  • Establishing “one agreed definition” for critical onboarding, credit and portfolio KPIs used across squads.
  • Reducing time spent reconciling numbers across reports, dashboards and AI outputs.
  • Enabling scalable self-serve analytics with clear, discoverable, versioned metric definitions.
  • Maintaining a stable, performant semantic layer with strong controls and auditability.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4467075044.descriptionHtml:
About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Job Description

Title Senior Technical Consultant

Department Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services

Location Dalian

Reports To Head of Canada Services

Level Grade 6

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services provides technology delivery, engineering and operational support to Fidelity Clearing Canada (FCC). The team partners closely with FCC Technology, Product, Business and Operations to deliver, maintain and modernize business-critical platforms and services for external clients and internal business lines.

About Your Role

As Senior Technical Consultant, you will provide senior hands-on technical expertise for the maintenance, support and modernization of .NET-based trading systems within Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services. You will work across legacy application assessment, solution architecture, software engineering and technical delivery, helping the team understand existing codebases, reduce technology risk and define pragmatic modernization paths. A key part of the role will be to leverage AI-enabled engineering and code analysis tools, alongside traditional engineering practices, to accelerate codebase understanding, identify risks and dependencies, support refactoring and remediation, and help define and implement the target modernization approach. You will work closely with Technical Architecture, Product, Business, Operations, Information Security, engineering and vendor teams across FCC and FIL to translate business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions. The role requires strong hands-on .NET engineering capability combined with solution architecture and design skills, with responsibility spanning application maintenance, production support, refactoring, modernization, integration, technical debt reduction and engineering quality. Finance, trading system, capital-markets or investment domain knowledge is a plus.

What You Will Do

  • Provide senior hands-on technical leadership for the assessment, maintenance, enhancement and modernization of .NET-based trading applications and supporting services.
  • Analyse existing and legacy codebases, application architecture, dependencies and integrations to identify technical risks, maintainability concerns, end-of-life components and modernization opportunities, using AI-enabled code analysis tools where appropriate to accelerate and deepen the assessment.
  • Design and implement robust solutions using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET, RESTful APIs, SQL and related Microsoft technologies, applying appropriate architecture and integration patterns.
  • Define and implement pragmatic modernization and refactoring approaches that improve maintainability, reliability, security and scalability while protecting continuity of critical business services, leveraging AI-assisted engineering to accelerate remediation where appropriate.
  • Provide solution architecture and detailed technical design, including application components, APIs, integrations, data flows, deployment patterns and non-functional requirements.
  • Support application maintenance and Level 3 production support, including incident investigation, root-cause analysis, defect remediation, performance troubleshooting and application upgrades.
  • Promote strong engineering practices covering automated testing, code quality, secure coding, CI/CD, observability, documentation, operational readiness and technical debt management, ensuring AI-generated recommendations and code are appropriately reviewed and validated.
  • Work closely with architecture, business, product, operations, security, infrastructure and vendor teams to understand requirements, evaluate solution options and coordinate delivery dependencies.
  • Provide technical estimation, implementation planning and clear communication of technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies and remediation priorities to Canada Services and FCC stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI-enabled engineering tools to accelerate code understanding, dependency and risk analysis, refactoring, modernization, testing and documentation, while applying strong technical judgement and appropriate architecture, security, quality and governance controls.

About You

You bring extensive hands-on software engineering experience with strong expertise in C# and the Microsoft .NET technology stack, including development, maintenance and modernization of complex enterprise applications. You have demonstrated solution architecture and technical design capability and can move comfortably between architecture-level decisions and hands-on code analysis and implementation. You have experience assessing legacy applications, refactoring complex codebases, managing technical debt and remediating obsolete or end-of-life technologies. You understand APIs and integration patterns, SQL and relational databases, secure software development, automated testing, CI/CD and production support for business-critical systems. You are comfortable leveraging AI-enabled software engineering tools for code analysis, codebase understanding, refactoring, testing, documentation and modernization, while critically validating AI-generated outputs and applying appropriate security, architecture and engineering controls. You can troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and work effectively across distributed business, technology and vendor teams. Experience with AI-assisted software engineering is highly desirable. Finance or financial-services domain knowledge, particularly experience with trading systems, capital markets or investment platforms, is a plus.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

ln:4478795247.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are Looking For

Reporting to an AVP, the Officer is responsible for delivering end-to-end fund administration services, overseeing several team members and ensuring team compliance with operating policies, procedures and guidelines in the timely completion of accurate Net Asset Valuations (NAV). They are also responsible for team development and/or staff management. In addition, the Officer will also be involved with and drive projects such as the provision of management reporting, BCP and Risk initiatives, as well as ad hoc project work with the objectives of enhancing client satisfaction or winning operational efficiencies.

Why This Role Is Important To Us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized industry leader in providing fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to hedge funds, private markets, and other alternative investment vehicles. AIS delivers fully integrated solutions across the investment lifecycle, providing clients with comprehensive front-, middle-, and back-office support to meet the evolving needs of institutional investors.

Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Hedge Fund Accounting Officer you will be responsible for

Net Asset Value Operations

  • Maintain primary portfolio and accounting records for a variety of onshore and offshore hedge fund partnerships and corporations, trading in all types of investment securities and products
  • Familiar with end-to-end NAV processes and in-depth business knowledge on Hedge products and systems
  • Calculate daily/weekly/monthly Net Asset Valuations for the purpose of reporting to investors and processing of investor subscription and withdrawal activity
  • Allocate gains and losses amongst investors and calculate and accrue management and performance fees payable to hedge fund managers
  • Prepare tax lot accounting reports and schedules and assist in preparation of annual financial statements
  • Prepare fund performance reports including annual summaries and weekly return estimates
  • Prepare ad hoc portfolio, performance and fee reports as requested by Home-sites
  • Maintain primary accounting records for hedge fund management companies


Communication and Stakeholder Contact

  • Provide support for and effectively communicate both homesite, local managers and teams
  • Manage relationships with internal clients (other State Street offices outsourcing to Hangzhou) at appropriate levels to ensure continued confidence in the Hangzhou office. This might include late night and early morning conference calls across all time zones.
  • Responsible for key operational metrics, SLAs, KPIs etc.
  • Become familiar with our global product offering


Training, People Development and Knowledge Management

  • Develop and monitor individual development plans for key people in the team.
  • Address the queries from the team and provide guidance and support from technical perspective, responsible for SOP set-up and review
  • Improve and build training mechanism for hedge new starters, knowledge management and experience sharing
  • Support internal rotations and succession plans within the unit
  • Lead improvement and transformation projects collaborating with home sites and Hangzhou Hedge Unit Head, serve on committees and task force assignments
  • Working with teams on productivity and efficiency improvement What we value:This role requires strong communication, people leadership, and client service skills, along with relevant industry experience. The ideal candidate demonstrates a growth mindset, embraces AI and digital tools to enhance ways of working, drive operational efficiency, and deliver better business outcomes. Education & Preferred Qualifications:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree and/or professional qualifications such as CPA, CFA, ACCA is a plus
  • At least 5 years working experience in accounting / financial services related environment.
  • Hedge fund administration industry experience essential including familiarity with performance fee structures, hot issue allocations and management company record keeping· Detailed understanding of how to account for, value and service all types of investment products including derivatives, swaps, options, futures and forwards· Understand unit strategic/business plan; ability to support strategic direction for areas of responsibility and ensure goals/objectives are aligned with those of the business
    • Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization and with clients
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to organizational success; work to do what is best for the organization and its stakeholders (e.g., customers, shareholders and employees)
  • Demonstrated ability to make and stand by difficult or unpopular decisions when they are in the best interests of the client or corporation· Demonstrates an appreciation for people and perspectives that differ from own; ability to adapt style to match the needs of different individuals, teams and situations· Good interpersonal skills and ability to interface with colleagues from all disciplines, backgrounds and cultures - both in the region and across the globe

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

Read our CEO Statement
